race.comment: COMPEL (7) sets the standard off a brief break, having won stylishly on debut at Doomben before finishing fifth in strong Saturday company. Her latest trial was a solid second at Doomben, and that gives her the right readiness profile to resume strongly. ZIA MARIA (5) was super in her maiden campaign, closing off the prep with back-to-back wins. Has been fitted with two trials and can make a bright return. MY UTOPIA (8) also returns and will be looking to build on from what was a successful debut prep. Her Poly trial win in readiness suggests she's come back in good touch. CAUSE SHE CAN (3) arrives in winning touch after scoring over this trip at the latest, arrives at her top fourth-up. Have to take seriously.
